description: This file defines a customer authentication API client, including functions for login and registration via HTTP requests, token and profile extraction, and configuration of API endpoints.

methods.name: createCustomerAuthApi
methods.description: Creates an API client for customer authentication, providing login and registration functions.

methods.name: loginBackend
methods.description: Attempts to log in a customer by trying multiple endpoint paths and extracting tokens and profile info from responses.

methods.name: registerBackend
methods.description: Attempts to register a customer via multiple endpoint paths and extracts tokens and profile info.
